name: Yamagata Ai
source:
Ai Yamagata is a student in year one of class three. She is good friends with Sekai Saionji and Hikari Kuroda, and is an acquaintance of Makoto Ito and Otome Kato from middle school.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_School_Days_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
